_comment: Example bank-account seed data. Copy to seed_accounts.json (gitignored) and replace with your real accounts. dmt_bank_accounts feed the DMT account registry; evalue_accounts feed the E-Value account master. IMPORTANT: each reco_acc_no must EXACTLY equal the value that appears in your internal dump's `source` column — E-Value matching joins on it. Accounts can also be managed in the UI under Configuration → Bank Accounts / E-Value Accounts.
